story.title: Goldilocks and the Three Bears
story.description: Lost in the forest, a girl wanders into the empty home of a family of bears and tries out everything she finds.
story.author: Traditional English folklore

scenes.name: A house in the woods
scenes.summary: Lost in the forest, Goldilocks finds a small, empty house and walks in uninvited.

scenes.name: The three bowls of soup
scenes.summary: Hungry, she tries the three bowls of soup on the table and eats all of Baby Bear's, the only one at just the right temperature.

scenes.name: The three chairs
scenes.summary: She tries the three chairs in the living room and ends up breaking the smallest one, Baby Bear's.

scenes.name: The three beds
scenes.summary: Tired, she goes upstairs and tries the three beds, falling fast asleep in Baby Bear's bed.

scenes.name: The fright and the flight
scenes.summary: The three bears come home, find the mess and the girl asleep in his bed; startled, Goldilocks jumps out the window and runs off into the forest, never to return.

characters.name: Goldilocks
characters.description: A curious girl who loses her way in the forest on the way home.
characters.personality: Curious and impulsive, quick to help herself to whatever catches her eye.
characters.motivation: Just wants to rest and eat after getting lost - and can't resist trying everything in an empty house.
characters.qualities: Adventurous and unbothered by walking into a stranger's home uninvited.
characters.weaknesses: Never stops to consider that the house belongs to someone until it's far too late.
characters.biography: A girl who wanders off the path home through the forest and stumbles on the Three Bears' empty house.
characters.plannedTimeline: Flees out the window when the bears return, and is never seen in the forest again.

characters.name: Papa Bear
characters.description: The largest of the three bears, owner of the big chair and bed.
characters.personality: Gruff but even-tempered, the first to notice something is wrong in the house.
characters.motivation: Wants only to come home to a peaceful meal after a walk in the woods.
characters.qualities: Observant - the first to notice his porridge and chair have been disturbed.
characters.weaknesses: His big, booming voice tends to announce trouble before anyone can act on it.
characters.biography: The father of the bear family, whose oversized bowl, chair, and bed set the pattern Goldilocks tries all three of.
characters.plannedTimeline: Returns home to find every one of his belongings disturbed, and joins in discovering the sleeping intruder.

characters.name: Mama Bear
characters.description: The middle bear, owner of the medium chair and bed.
characters.personality: Practical and quick to keep the household in order.
characters.motivation: Wants the family's home and belongings kept just the way they should be.
characters.qualities: Even-keeled - the calmest of the three when the mess is discovered.
characters.weaknesses: Her medium-sized things are always the ones passed over as "not quite right" by Goldilocks.
characters.biography: The mother of the bear family, whose porridge, chair, and bed are each tried and rejected in turn.
characters.plannedTimeline: Discovers her own belongings disturbed just before Baby Bear finds his ruined entirely.

characters.name: Baby Bear
characters.description: The smallest of the three bears, owner of the small chair, soup, and bed.
characters.personality: High-pitched and easily upset - the one who suffers the most from Goldilocks's visit.
characters.motivation: Just wants his breakfast, his chair, and his bed left exactly as he left them.
characters.qualities: The most sympathetic of the three - everything sized just for him is the one thing Goldilocks likes best, and ruins.
characters.weaknesses: Too small to stop anything - his soup is eaten, his chair is broken, and his bed is slept in before he ever gets a say.
characters.biography: The youngest of the bear family, whose porridge, chair, and bed turn out to be exactly Goldilocks's size.
characters.plannedTimeline: Finds his chair broken and Goldilocks asleep in his own bed, the moment that finally wakes her and sends her fleeing.

locations.name: The Forest
locations.description: Dense woods where Goldilocks loses her way.
locations.climate: Thick with trees and easy to get lost in, with no clear paths to follow.

locations.name: The Three Bears' House
locations.description: A cozy little house in the middle of the forest, with everything in three sizes.
locations.climate: Warm and homely, freshly emptied while the porridge cools from breakfast.
locations.culture: A small, orderly bear family household where everything - bowls, chairs, beds - comes in a big, medium, and small size.
